import ipaddress, hashlib
for t in ['2001:db8::/ffff::','2001:db8::/+56','2001:db8::/0056','2001:db8::0.0.0.0/56','2001:db8::/64%eth0','2001:db8::/56%eth0','2001:db8::1%eth0/56','2001:db8::/']:
    try:
        n = ipaddress.IPv6Network(t, strict=True)
        print(repr(t), '->', n, n.prefixlen)
    except Exception as e:
        print(repr(t), '-> ERR', type(e).__name__, e)
for t in ['2001:db8::/64','2001:db8::1%eth0','2001:db8::/64']:
    try:
        print(repr(t),'addr->',ipaddress.IPv6Address(t))
    except Exception as e:
        print(repr(t),'addr ERR',e)

payload = 'ipv6-evidence-v1\n17\nmorning\nhome\n2001:db8:1234:5600::/64\n'.encode('ascii')
d = hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()
c0 = int.from_bytes(d[:8],'big') | (1<<63)
print('c0 =', hex(c0), ipaddress.IPv6Address(0x20010db812345600 << 64 | c0))
print('c1 =', ipaddress.IPv6Address(0x20010db812345600 << 64 | (c0^1)))
payload2 = 'ipv6-evidence-v1\n17\nmorning\nhome\n2001:db8:1234:5603::/64\n'.encode('ascii')
d2 = hashlib.sha256(payload2).digest()
c02 = int.from_bytes(d2[:8],'big') | (1<<63)
print('c0b =', ipaddress.IPv6Address(0x20010db812345603 << 64 | c02), ipaddress.IPv6Address(0x20010db812345603 << 64 | (c02^1)))
